description: A single green parrot with a yellow-orange head perches on a gnarled bare branch in a dim, glass-roofed aviary of iron bars. Other perches are bare, and more cages with bare branches sit at the left and right edges. Through the back grille there is a dark ornate iron structure with snow-like light outside. The scene is painted in a heavy, dark oil style with no visible text, frame or people.
